name: momentMap
stmt: noncomputable def momentMap (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * g a

name: variance
doc: 指数族方差：V(θ) = E[g²] − E[g]² = Σ_a q_a·g_a² − (Σ_a q_a·g_a)²。
stmt: noncomputable def variance (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * (g a) ^ 2 - (momentMap g θ) ^ 2

name: variance_nonneg
stmt:
theorem variance_nonneg [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ variance g θ
proof:
by
  have hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ gibbsDist g θ a := fun a => le_of_lt (gibbsDist_pos g θ a)
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun a => Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a))
    (g := fun a => Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)
  have hx : (∑ a, Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)
        * (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)) = momentMap g θ := by
    unfold momentMap
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [show Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)
        = (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)) * g a by ring,
      Real.mul_self_sqrt (hq a)]
  have hf : (∑ a, (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)) ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hq a)), gibbsDist_sum g θ]
  have hg' : (∑ a, (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a) ^ 2)
      = ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * (g a) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hq a)]
  rw [hx, hf, hg', one_mul] at hcs
  unfold variance
  linarith

name: momentMap_eq_deriv_logZ
stmt:
theorem momentMap_eq_deriv_logZ [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => Real.log (gibbsPartition g t)) θ = momentMap g θ
proof:
by
  have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun t => gibbsPartition g t)
      (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) θ := by
    unfold gibbsPartition
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    simpa using h2
  have hZpos : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have hlog := hZ.log hZpos
  rw [hlog.deriv]
  unfold momentMap gibbsDist
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: variance_eq_quotient
doc:
方差的有理化形式（N = Σ_a g_a·e^{θg_a}、N' = Σ_a g_a²·e^{θg_a}、Z' = Σ_a e^{θg_a}·g_a）：
V(θ) = (N'·Z(θ) − N·Z') / Z(θ)²。
stmt:
lemma variance_eq_quotient [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    variance g θ
      = ((∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) * gibbsPartition g θ
          - (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (θ * g a)) * (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a))
        / gibbsPartition g θ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hZ : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have h1 : ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * (g a) ^ 2
      = (∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) / gibbsPartition g θ := by
    unfold gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  have h2 : ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * g a
      = (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) / gibbsPartition g θ := by
    unfold gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  have h3 : (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (θ * g a)) = (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  unfold variance momentMap
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  field_simp [hZ]
  ring

name: momentMap_deriv
stmt:
theorem momentMap_deriv [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (momentMap g) θ = variance g θ
proof:
by
  have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun t => gibbsPartition g t)
      (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) θ := by
    unfold gibbsPartition
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    simpa using h2
  have hN : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ a, g a * Real.exp (t * g a))
      (∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) θ := by
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    have h3 := h2.const_mul (g a)
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h3
  have hZpos : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have hdiv := hN.div hZ hZpos
  have hfun : momentMap g
      = fun t => (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (t * g a)) / gibbsPartition g t := by
    funext t
    unfold momentMap gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  rw [hfun, hdiv.deriv, variance_eq_quotient]

name: momentMap_strictMono
doc:
矩映射严格单调递增：∂_θ momentMap = V > 0 ⟹ StrictMono（`strictMono_of_deriv_pos`）。
（V > 0 是显式假设，见「诚实边界」。）
stmt:
theorem momentMap_strictMono [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hvar : ∀ θ, 0 < variance g θ) : StrictMono (momentMap g)
proof:
strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun θ => by
    rw [momentMap_deriv g θ]
    exact hvar θ)

name: momentMap_injective
stmt:
theorem momentMap_injective (g : Fin k → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono (momentMap g)) :
    Function.Injective (momentMap g)
proof: hmono.injective

name: unique_theta_for_moment
doc:
给定目标矩 m 在矩映射值域内、且矩映射严格单调 ⟹ 存在唯一 θ 使 momentMap(g,θ) = m。
   「存在」由 hrange 直接给出，「唯一」由严格单调的单射性。
stmt:
theorem unique_theta_for_moment (g : Fin k → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono (momentMap g)) (hrange : ∃ θ, momentMap g θ = m) :
    ∃! θ, momentMap g θ = m
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨θ0, hθ0⟩ := hrange
  refine ⟨θ0, hθ0, ?_⟩
  intro θ hθ
  exact hmono.injective (by rw [hθ, hθ0])

name: unique_theta_for_moment_of_mono
stmt:
theorem unique_theta_for_moment_of_mono [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hvar : ∀ θ, 0 < variance g θ) (m : ℝ)
    (hrange : ∃ θ, momentMap g θ = m) :
    ∃! θ, momentMap g θ = m
proof:
unique_theta_for_moment g m (momentMap_strictMono g hvar) hrange

end Lattice

name: marginalRow
doc: 行边缘（第一分量的边缘分布）：mr_a = Σ_b p_ab。
stmt: noncomputable def marginalRow (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (a : Fin m) : ℝ
proof: ∑ b, p a b

name: marginalCol
doc: 列边缘（第二分量的边缘分布）：mc_b = Σ_a p_ab。
stmt: noncomputable def marginalCol (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, p a b

name: prodDist
doc: 边缘乘积（独立联合分布）：q_ab = mr_a·mc_b。
stmt: noncomputable def prodDist (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (a : Fin m) (b : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: marginalRow p a * marginalCol p b

name: mutualInformation
doc:
互信息（KL 形式）：MI(p) = Σ_{a,b} p_ab·(log p_ab − log(mr_a·mc_b))。
`log` 为全函数，定义无需假设。
stmt: noncomputable def mutualInformation (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * (Real.log (p a b) - Real.log (prodDist p a b))

name: gibbs_term
stmt:
lemma gibbs_term {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    x - y ≤ x * (Real.log x - Real.log y)
proof: gibbs_ineq hx hy

name: marginalRow_nonneg
stmt:
lemma marginalRow_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b) (a : Fin m) :
    0 ≤ marginalRow p a
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hp0 a b)

name: marginalCol_nonneg
stmt:
lemma marginalCol_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b) (b : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ marginalCol p b
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => hp0 a b)

name: prodDist_pos
stmt:
lemma prodDist_pos (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (a : Fin m) (b : Fin n)
    (hr : 0 < marginalRow p a) (hc : 0 < marginalCol p b) : 0 < prodDist p a b
proof: mul_pos hr hc

name: prodDist_sum
stmt:
lemma prodDist_sum (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, prodDist p a b) = (∑ a, marginalRow p a) * (∑ b, marginalCol p b)
proof:
by
  unfold prodDist
  calc
    (∑ a, ∑ b, marginalRow p a * marginalCol p b)
        = ∑ a, marginalRow p a * (∑ b, marginalCol p b) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (∑ a, marginalRow p a) * (∑ b, marginalCol p b) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: mi_as_sum_log_ratio
stmt:
theorem mi_as_sum_log_ratio (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 < p a b)
    (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a) (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    mutualInformation p = ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b / prodDist p a b)
proof:
by
  unfold mutualInformation
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp0 a b)) (ne_of_gt (prodDist_pos p a b (hr a) (hc b)))]

name: mutual_information_nonneg
stmt:
theorem mutual_information_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b)
    (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1)
    (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a) (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    0 ≤ mutualInformation p
proof:
by
  have hcol : ∑ b, marginalCol p b = 1 := by
    unfold marginalCol
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hsum
  have hq : ∑ a, ∑ b, prodDist p a b = 1 := by
    rw [prodDist_sum]
    have hrow : ∑ a, marginalRow p a = 1 := hsum
    rw [hrow, hcol, one_mul]
  have hterm : ∀ a b,
      p a b - prodDist p a b ≤ p a b * (Real.log (p a b) - Real.log (prodDist p a b)) := by
    intro a b
    exact gibbs_term (hp0 a b) (prodDist_pos p a b (hr a) (hc b))
  have hsumdiff : ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - prodDist p a b) = 0 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hsum, hq]
    ring
  calc
    0 = ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - prodDist p a b) := hsumdiff.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * (Real.log (p a b) - Real.log (prodDist p a b)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => hterm a b))
    _ = mutualInformation p := rfl

name: mutual_information_comm
stmt:
theorem mutual_information_comm (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    mutualInformation p = mutualInformation (fun (b : Fin n) (a : Fin m) => p a b)
proof:
by
  simp only [mutualInformation, prodDist, marginalRow, marginalCol]
  conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm]

name: mi_eq_zero_of_independent
stmt:
theorem mi_eq_zero_of_independent (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a b, p a b = prodDist p a b) : mutualInformation p = 0
proof:
by
  unfold mutualInformation
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro b _
  rw [h a b, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: marginalRow_sum_eq_one
stmt:
lemma marginalRow_sum_eq_one (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1) :
    ∑ a, marginalRow p a = 1
proof: hsum

name: marginalCol_sum_eq_one
stmt:
lemma marginalCol_sum_eq_one (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1) :
    ∑ b, marginalCol p b = 1
proof:
by
  unfold marginalCol
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact hsum

end Lattice
